cabecalho.descricao: Curta-metragem da temporada Londrina da Catarina.

citacao.p: Anyway, after my graduation I was pretty broke. But creative. In order to have something on my showreel for agents and casting directors to see, I wrote a script for a short film called ‘Drinking & Bleeding’ and produced it. Basically ‘producing it’ meant asking favours and saving money. For example Len Whybrow the director and my flat mate at the time and I waited with the graded material in a pub in Soho until the editor was finished with his regular paying client. Then I spend him a couple of pints and we went up editing all night and leaving the Post House through the back door in the morning with a final cut. Beside Catarina Furtado with whom I had studied and I played the main part in this film. Len had found the cross-eyed, but brilliant swiss cameraman Martin Guggisberg to film it in a small Café in Brixton on 16mm. Apart from the fact that we sold the film to Portugal television for $ 800.- due to the fact that Catarina was already well known over there – it got me an agent in Germany.
